title: Caveman route ask v1
description: The body a signed-in local runtime posts to Cloud's POST /v1/route, at most 256 KiB: the caller's models, counts computed on the machine, and the ask Cloud picks the model from (the latest human turn, the one before it and the end of the agent's last reply). Those turns go raw, including whatever the agent writes into them, such as CLAUDE.md or memory reminders, @-mentioned file contents, shell output, compaction summaries, or Codex AGENTS.md and environment blocks; structured tool calls, tool results and the system prompt are not sent. The tenant comes from the bearer token, never from the body. Cloud answers with one of the models, or the runtime keeps the asked one.

models.description: The model the agent asked for first, then the other models of the same provider it may move to.

agent.description: The wrapped agent: claude, codex, …; unlabeled-agent when unknown.

tool_errors.description: Tool results in the request marked as errors.

ask.description: The conversation, raw as the agent sent it. Turns are input groups: the items between two model outputs (an assistant message, a tool call, reasoning). A group that carries a tool result (an Anthropic tool_result block, an OpenAI chat tool or function message, a Responses *_output item or mcp_approval_response) belongs to the tool loop and is no human turn, with any text riding along: injected reminders, an interrupt note, or a redirect typed after an interrupt, which is therefore not sent (the next human turn is). Any other group with a user message is one human turn, read from its last user message only, whose text blocks are joined with "\n"; when that message has no text (an image), no ask is sent. Byte bounds are UTF-8; every field keeps its end, cut on a rune boundary. Optional fields are left out when empty. Sent together with signals.

text.description: The latest human turn. At most 131072 bytes, keeping the end.

prev_text.description: The human turn before the latest one. At most 16384 bytes, keeping the end.

reply_tail.description: The newest assistant text (not tool calls) before the latest human turn. At most 16384 bytes, keeping the end.

turn.description: Human turns before the latest one.
